bug_semantics: check_unsafe_options is fed reconstructed candidates from Git._option_candidates rather than the argv transform_kwarg actually emits. For a one-character kwarg with split_single_char_options=False, candidates contain only '-n' while transform_kwarg emits the joined token '-nVALUE'. Git then clusters that token (e.g. -n + -u<cmd>) into --upload-pack, so clone_from/fetch/pull/push/ls_remote/archive/blame/iter_commits execute an attacker command at default allow_unsafe_options=False.

That first write appends only '-{key}' / '--{dashify(key)}' and never the joined '-{key}{value}' form that transform_kwarg already produced when split_single_char_options=False.
